title: AppStack spec
description: The friendly spec. Identical in requests/<name>.json (NGO/GO) and spec: of the AppStack XR (XP).

zone.description: Cloudflare zone (apex domain) the app lives in

tier.description: Platform sizing profile: observability, replication, rate limits

exposure.description: public: WAF only; private: + Zero Trust Access; hybrid: + load balancer to external origins

database.description: d1 = managed replicated SQLite; postgres = Hyperdrive to an external Postgres

objects.description: An R2 bucket for application objects

container.description: The Worker fronts a Cloudflare Container (deployed with wrangler)

origins.description: External origins; required when exposure = hybrid
